summary: Bible Phase 3 (Piani di Lettura) frontend flows tested end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). GUEST, LOGGED-IN USER, and ADMIN paths all pass. Home 'Leggi la Bibbia' card (testID home-open-bible) opens /lettore. Bible home shows Piani di Lettura card (bible-plans-card) and header icon (bible-plans-open) both navigating to /lettore/piani. The 2 seeded plans (Incontra Gesu / Le Promesse di Dio) are listed with testIDs plan-plan_f52148d87254 and plan-plan_8b9c8ddabe4e. Plan detail renders correctly. As a LOGGED-IN user (test@pescatoridiuomini.it): plan-enroll enrolls and reveals plan-reset + progress bar (0/7 - 0%); plan-day-toggle-1 marks day complete (progress -> 1/7 - 14%); plan-day-1-reading-0 navigates to /lettore/read?book=43&chapter=1 (Giovanni 1). As GUEST: tapping plan-enroll shows a login alert and navigates away (does NOT crash), but the redirect landed on '/' instead of '/auth' - the router.push('/auth') call did not visibly reach /auth (possibly a guest-mode guard redirect); it's not a crash but slightly deviates from the spec. ADMIN (pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it): /admin/reading-plans shows 2 plans, sidebar has admin-nav-plans, plan-create opens editor, and creating a plan (title=TEST_ReadPlan_QA + published + day 0 with Genesi ch.1) via plan-save succeeds (alert 'Salvato' fired) and the plan appears in the list (3 total). Cleanup: test plan deleted via API (status 200), final list back to 2 seeded plans.

integration_issues.issue: As guest, tapping plan-enroll fires alertMessage then router.push('/auth'), but final URL landed on '/' (root) not '/auth'. The route.push('/auth') seems to be intercepted by a guard (likely welcome/guest gate) so the login prompt is dismissed and the user ends up on Home instead of the auth screen. Not a crash and non-blocking, but the spec expects the user to reach /auth.

Clicking plan-delete triggers window.confirm; Playwright's dialog handler accepts, but the click promise on the PressableScale element hangs (times out) even though the deletion side effect likely fires. This is a react-native-web + confirmAsync quirk. E2E tests should call the DELETE API directly for cleanup. No user-visible bug in real usage but worth noting for automated test stability.

issues: Layout is clean; hero + plan cards spacing follows 8pt grid; touch targets adequate.
Progress bar and day checklist are visually clear; day toggle (44x44) accessible.
List rows, status pills, and create FAB render correctly on mobile.

action_items: Verify the guest-enroll redirect target. When a guest taps plan-enroll on /lettore/piano/[id], alertMessage is shown then router.push('/auth') is called; but on web the user ends up on '/'. Investigate whether a global guard (welcome/guest gate) intercepts /auth and consider using router.replace('/welcome') or ensuring /auth is reachable from guest mode.

(Optional) For automated E2E stability, consider decoupling plan-delete from window.confirm on web (e.g., use in-app confirm modal), since confirmAsync-triggered dialog causes the Playwright click promise to hang even though the delete succeeds.
critical_code_review_comments: Reading plan flows are well-factored, use testIDs consistently, and handle guest/auth states via useAuth + requireLogin gates.
admin/reading-plans/[id].tsx validates title + per-day readings before save; cleanDays filter drops empty readings; good UX.
confirmAsync + alertMessage utilities appear to rely on native browser dialogs on web - fine for prod but produces the Playwright quirk noted above.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (10/10 core flows pass; 1 minor deviation on guest -> /auth redirect)
